Conversely, the opposing case to the favorable earnings reading is that the noninterest income decline was concentrated in an asset sale/write-down line that is inherently lumpy, so its drop may say little about recurring fee momentum, and the tax provision rose alongside pretax income, which is an arithmetic consequence rather than a separate negative.
